name: BIL
what: Uzbek speech intelligence: transcribe, pull key points, summarise
body:
Record a lecture, a meeting or a voice note in Uzbek and get back a transcript, the key points and a short summary.

- Uzbek speech-to-text
- Key-point extraction and summarisation on top of the transcript
- Syncs across devices

name: Uzbek Gemma
what: Uzbek-first LLM: continued pretraining and SFT on Gemma 4
body:
A tuning pipeline that teaches Gemma 4 to think in Uzbek first.

- Continued pretraining on Uzbek text
- Supervised fine-tuning on instructions
- Trained on a rented Linux GPU box

name: OpenClaw
what: Talk to a lidar robot on a Raspberry Pi in plain language
body:
Tell the robot what to do in plain words and an LLM turns it into safe motion.

- Raspberry Pi 5 with a lidar
- ROS 2 running in Docker, bridged to the model through MCP tools
- Safety logic between the model and the motors

name: CTF Platform
what: Auto-solver and team management for capture-the-flag events
body:
Tooling for team XYLO: an agent that takes a first pass at challenges, plus the boring parts of running a team.

- Works with CTFd and rCTF boards
- Team and challenge management

name: Vibe
what: Reads a song and shows its mood and structure
body: Drop in a track and see how it moves: mood over time and where the sections change.

name: Credit scoring
what: Loan default prediction for the CBU Coding Challenge
body: A loan-default model built for the Central Bank of Uzbekistan's Coding Challenge. Took 3rd place.

name: ACAR
body: Analytics and reporting that help spot corruption risk in the data.
